name: Home Zone Furniture - Round Rock
subject: Warranty and delivery damage repair
body:
Hi Home Zone Furniture team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather furniture repair shop in Lakeway. When a piece gets damaged in delivery or a customer files a warranty claim, we can usually repair it for less than replacing it. We also touch up floor models.

Who handles service and warranty on your side? I'd like to send them our details.

Dillon
(737) 247-7484
dillon@lerega.com

name: Heritage Office Suites - Georgetown
subject: Office chair repair
body:
Hi Heritage Office Suites team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather repair shop in Lakeway. We repair and re-cover office chairs and lounge furniture, which usually costs much less than buying new. We can pick up and bring everything back.

If you send me photos of the pieces that need work, I'll get you prices.

Dillon
(737) 247-7484
dillon@lerega.com
